Let the order dated 09.08.2023 passed in this case be treated as Order No. 4 in place of Order No. 2.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the State and the learned counsel for the informant.
3. This application has been filed for quashing of the order dated 19.12.2016 passed by the learned Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate-VI, Samastipur in Pusa P.S. Case No. 96 of 2016 by which the Court below took cognizance against the petitioner under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 504, 506/34 of the IPC and Section  of the DP Act.

4. As per the prosecution case, the informant has alleged that after two months of marriage, the family members Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.3233 of 2018(5) dt.07-07-2025 of her in-laws started demanding dowry and due to non- fulfillment of demand of dowry, she was subjected to cruelty and torture.

5. It has jointly been submitted by the learned counsels for both the parties that the parties have Sanjeev Kaushal vs State Of Bihar And Anr on 7 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107041827/
